hero.badge: NO ACCOUNT · NO CARD · NO WATERMARK
hero.subtitle: Pull any YouTube video in up to 4K, lift the audio, cut an exact segment, grab the thumbnail, or pull the full transcript. One paste, one click, done.

features.heading: One link in.
features.subheading: Every tool below is already running in the app. Nothing here is a roadmap promise.

download.title: Download up to 4K
download.description: Pick any resolution the video actually offers, from 144p to 2160p. Video and audio streams are fetched separately and merged with FFmpeg, so you get one clean file at full quality.

trim.title: Frame-accurate trimming
trim.description: Scrub the timeline, mark a start and end, and take only that segment. Set the cut against the live player instead of guessing timestamps.

audio.title: Audio extraction
audio.description: Drop the video track entirely and keep the best available audio stream for podcasts, lectures, or music.

transcript.title: Full transcript
transcript.description: Pull the video's captions as searchable text, then copy them or save them to a file. Works with both manual and auto-generated captions.

subtitles.title: Burned-in subtitles
subtitles.description: Render captions directly into the picture with your choice of style, font, size, and position — ready for feeds that mute autoplay.

privacy.title: Nothing is kept
privacy.description: There is no account and no library. Your file lives on the server only long enough for you to download it, then a cleanup job removes it permanently.

howItWorks.heading: From link to file in
howItWorks.subheading: No setup, no configuration, no account to create first.

paste.title: Paste the link
paste.description: Any YouTube watch, Shorts, or youtu.be link works. Playlist parameters are stripped automatically.

analyze.title: Read the formats
analyze.description: Clipora reads the real stream list straight from the source and shows only the qualities that genuinely exist.

configure.title: Choose the output
configure.description: Pick a resolution, switch to audio, mark a trim range, or select a transcript or thumbnail instead.

download.title: Save the file
download.description: Progress streams live while the server works. The moment it finishes, the file downloads straight to your device.

cost.question: Is there a catch? Do I need an account?
cost.answer: No account, no payment, no trial timer. Paste a link and use it. There is nothing to sign up for.

quality.question: Why is 4K missing on some videos?
quality.answer: Clipora only shows resolutions the video genuinely publishes. If the uploader never rendered above 1080p, no tool can invent a 4K version. The quality list you see is read live from the source.

privacy.question: What happens to my files?
privacy.answer: They are written to temporary server storage, served to you once, and then deleted by a scheduled cleanup job. There is no user library, no history, and no third-party analytics on your downloads.

restricted.question: Why did a video fail?
restricted.answer: Members-only, private, age-restricted, and region-blocked videos cannot be read without the matching account credentials, so they are refused with a clear reason rather than a silent failure.

playlists.question: Can I download a whole playlist or channel?
playlists.answer: Not currently. Clipora handles one video at a time by design. Paste a link that includes a playlist parameter and it will quietly target just that single video.

audio.question: Can I get audio only, without the video?
audio.answer: Yes. Switch the mode to audio and Clipora fetches the best available audio stream directly, skipping the video track entirely so the download is far smaller and faster.

finalCta.title: Stop fighting sketchy
finalCta.description: No pop-ups, no fake buttons, no watermark, no inbox harvesting. Paste a link and get your file.

footer.tagline: A clean, fast way to download, trim, and convert YouTube media — without the ad traps.
footer.disclaimer: Clipora is not affiliated with YouTube or Google. Please respect copyright and only download content you have the right to use.
